    IF (rPressDev_AB > 18.0) AND (rPressDev_AC > 18.0) THEN

    rSumA := rChilledWaterSupplyPress_A + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C;

    rVotedWaterPress_bar := (rChilledWaterSupplyPress_B + rChilledWaterSupplyPress_C) * 0.5;

ELSIF bCOChanFault_C AND NOT bCOChanFault_A AND NOT bCOChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_CO_ppm_B, rToxicGas_CO_ppm_C));
    bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* --- GROUP 5: NITROGEN DIOXIDE TOXIC BLAST FUME SENSORS (A, B, C) [ppm] --- *)
rNO2Dev_AB := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B);
rNO2Dev_BC := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
rNO2Dev_AC := ABS(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A - rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
tNO2DiscTimer(IN := ((rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) OR (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) OR (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5)), PT := T#800MS);

IF tNO2DiscTimer.Q THEN
    IF (rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5) THEN

    ELSIF (rNO2Dev_AB > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) THEN
        bNO2ChanFault_B := TRUE;
    ELSIF (rNO2Dev_AC > 2.5) AND (rNO2Dev_BC > 2.5) THEN
        bNO2ChanFault_C := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rSumA := rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A + rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B + rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C;
    rTempSort := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    rDeltaVal := MIN(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MIN(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := rSumA - rTempSort - rDeltaVal;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_B AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_C THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSIF bNO2ChanFault_C AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_A AND NOT bNO2ChanFault_B THEN
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B);
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 1;
ELSE
    rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm := MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_A, MAX(rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_B, rToxicGas_NO2_ppm_C));
    bAlarmLatch_TMR_Failure := TRUE;
    iTmrFaultAccumulator := iTmrFaultAccumulator + 2;
END_IF;

(* Flag degraded mode if any instrument channel has failed *)
bDegradedSensorMode := (iTmrFaultAccumulator > 0);

(* Toxic Gas Evacuation & Trip Interlocks *)
IF (rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm > 50.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighCO := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm > 3.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighNO2 := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;
IF (rToxicGas_CH4_LEL_pct > 20.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_HighCH4 := TRUE;
    bToxicGasTripActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 4: PSYCHROMETRIC ENTHALPY & DETERMINISTIC WET-BULB SOLVER                                          *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Modified Tetens equation with barometric autocompression scaling for deep mine shafts                                *)
(* Calculate saturation vapor pressure at dry-bulb temperature *)
rSatVaporPress_kPa := 0.61078 * EXP((17.27 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC) / (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC + 237.3));
rActualVaporPress_kPa := (rStopeRelativeHumidity / 100.0) * rSatVaporPress_kPa;

(* Humidity ratio: w = 0.62198 * Pv / (P_baro - Pv) *)
IF (rBarometricPressure_kPa - rActualVaporPress_kPa) > 10.0 THEN
    rHumidityRatio_kg_kg := 0.62198 * rActualVaporPress_kPa / (rBarometricPressure_kPa - rActualVaporPress_kPa);
ELSE
    rHumidityRatio_kg_kg := 0.035; (* Safe physical upper bound saturation limit *)
END_IF;

(* Specific air enthalpy: h = 1.006 * T_db + w * (2501.0 + 1.86 * T_db) [kJ/kg dry air] *)
rCalculatedAirEnthalpy_kJkg := (1.006 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC) + (rHumidityRatio_kg_kg * (2501.0 + (1.86 * rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC)));

(* Deterministic 6-step Newton-Raphson thermodynamic solver for Wet-Bulb Temperature *)
(* Avoids unbounded while loops to guarantee hard real-time cycle determinism *)
rWetBulbEstimate := rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - ((100.0 - rStopeRelativeHumidity) / 100.0) * ((rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - 10.0) * 0.35);
FOR iNewtonIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rSatVaporPress_Twb := 0.61078 * EXP((17.27 * rWetBulbEstimate) / (rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3));
    rPsychroResidual := rSatVaporPress_Twb - rActualVaporPress_kPa - (rBarometricPressure_kPa * rPsychroConstant * (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rWetBulbEstimate));
    rPsychroDerivative := (rSatVaporPress_Twb * (4098.0 / ((rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3) * (rWetBulbEstimate + 237.3)))) + (rBarometricPressure_kPa * rPsychroConstant);
    IF ABS(rPsychroDerivative) > 0.001 THEN
        rWetBulbEstimate := rWetBulbEstimate - (rPsychroResidual / rPsychroDerivative);
    END_IF;
END_FOR;
rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC := rWetBulbEstimate;

(* Geothermal refrigeration duty absorbed by chilled water cascade *)
(* Q_absorbed = m_dot * Cp * (T_return - T_supply) -> rho = 1000 kg/m3, Cp = 4.184 kJ/kg.K *)
rCalculatedRefrigerationEffect_kW := rChilledWaterFlowRate * 1000.0 * 4.184 * (rChilledWaterReturnTemp - rChilledWaterSupplyTemp);

(* Thermal Runaway Trip Check: Wet-Bulb exceeding regulatory legal limit 32.5 deg C *)
IF (rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC > 32.5) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_ThermalRunaway := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 5: JOUKOWSKY ACOUSTIC SURGE & WATER HAMMER MITIGATION                                              *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Pressure derivative dP/dt computed over scan interval Ts = 100ms                                                     *)
rPressureSlewRate_bar_s := (ABS(rVotedWaterPress_bar - rPrevScanPress)) / 0.100;
rPrevScanPress := rVotedWaterPress_bar;

(* Push into circular buffer for moving peak history *)
aPressHistory[iPressHistoryIdx] := rVotedWaterPress_bar;
iPressHistoryIdx := (iPressHistoryIdx + 1) MOD 10;

(* Detect catastrophic hydraulic water hammer surge (> 35.0 bar/s or > 420.0 bar) *)
tWaterHammerSustain(IN := (rPressureSlewRate_bar_s > 35.0) OR (rVotedWaterPress_bar > 420.0), PT := T#200MS);
IF tWaterHammerSustain.Q THEN
    bWaterHammerLatch := TRUE;
    bWaterHammerWarning := TRUE;
    bAlarmLatch_WaterHammer := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90; (* Force emergency lockout *)
END_IF;

(* Pelton overpressure threshold trip *)
IF (rVotedWaterPress_bar > 435.0) THEN
    bAlarmLatch_PeltonOverpress := TRUE;
    bEmergencyTripActive := TRUE;
    iFSM_CurrentState := 90;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 6: COANDA PLANAR AIR CURTAIN FLUID DYNAMICS & VECTORING                                             *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Dynamic vectoring adjusts vane pitch and yaw to counter thermal buoyancy and cross-drafts                            *)
(* Archimedes Number: Ar = g * beta * (T_stope - T_supply) * b0 / u0^2 *)
IF rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity > 2.0 THEN
    rCurtainArchimedesNumber := (9.81 * rThermalExpansionBeta * (rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rChilledWaterSupplyTemp) * rSlotNozzleWidth_m) / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity);
    rCurtainMomentumFlux := rAirDensity_kgm3 * rSlotNozzleWidth_m * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity * rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity;
ELSE
    rCurtainArchimedesNumber := 1.5; (* High buoyancy stall risk *)
    rCurtainMomentumFlux := 0.0;
    bAirCurtainStallAlarm := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Aerodynamic Pitch Elevation Vane Angle Calculation (counters buoyancy up-draft) *)
(* Pitch correction: Theta_pitch = K_buoy * Ar - K_cross * (v_cross / u_jet) *)
rRawPitchAngle := (18.5 * rCurtainArchimedesNumber) - (7.2 * (rCrossDraftAirVelocity / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity + 0.1)));
IF rRawPitchAngle > 30.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := 30.0;
ELSIF rRawPitchAngle < -30.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := -30.0;
ELSE
    rAirCurtainPitchAngle_deg := rRawPitchAngle;
END_IF;

(* Aerodynamic Yaw Angle Calculation (counters transverse drift) *)
rRawYawAngle := (rTransverseAirVelocity / (rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity + 0.1)) * 57.2958; (* Rad to deg *)
IF rRawYawAngle > 25.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := 25.0;
ELSIF rRawYawAngle < -25.0 THEN
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := -25.0;
ELSE
    rAirCurtainYawAngle_deg := rRawYawAngle;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* EXECUTION SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION                                            *)
(* ==================================================================================================================== *)
(* Receding horizon state error calculation *)
vX[0] := rVotedStopeDryBulb_degC - rTargetDryBulbTemp_degC;     (* e_Tdb: Dry-bulb deviation *)
vX[1] := rCalculatedStopeWetBulb_degC - rTargetWetBulbTemp_degC; (* e_Twb: Wet-bulb deviation *)
vX[2] := rAirCurtainSupplyVelocity - rTargetCurtainVelocity_ms; (* e_Ujet: Velocity error *)
vX[3] := rVotedBarrierDiffPress_mbar - rTargetBarrierPress_mbar; (* e_dP: Barrier pressure error *)

(* Analytical gradient computation of quadratic cost: Grad = B^T * Q * x + R * (u - u_prev) *)
FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
    rSumA := 0.0;
    FOR idx_i := 0 TO 3 DO
        rSumA := rSumA + (mB[idx_i, idx_j] * mQ[idx_i, idx_i] * vX[idx_i]);
    END_FOR;
    vGrad[idx_j] := rSumA + (mR[idx_j, idx_j] * (vU_optimal[idx_j] - vU_previous[idx_j]));
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Iteration Loop (Hard Real-Time Bound) *)
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO iMpcMaxIter DO
    FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
        (* Gradient descent step *)
        vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_optimal[idx_j] - (rMpcStepSize * vGrad[idx_j]);
        
        (* Actuator Slew Rate Clamping *)
        rDeltaVal := vU_optimal[idx_j] - vU_previous[idx_j];
        IF rDeltaVal > vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_previous[idx_j] + vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j];
        ELSIF rDeltaVal < -vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_previous[idx_j] - vDeltaU_clamp[idx_j];
        END_IF;
        
        (* Actuator Absolute Physical Box Constraint Projection *)
        IF vU_optimal[idx_j] > vU_max[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_max[idx_j];
        ELSIF vU_optimal[idx_j] < vU_min[idx_j] THEN
            vU_optimal[idx_j] := vU_min[idx_j];
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Save optimal commands for slew tracking in subsequent scan *)
FOR idx_j := 0 TO 3 DO
    vU_previous[idx_j] := vU_optimal[idx_j];
END_FOR;

        ELSIF bDegradedSensorMode AND NOT bAcknowledgeDegradedMode THEN

            iFSM_CurrentState := 40; (* Operator accepted degraded operation *)
        ELSIF bToxicGasTripActive THEN

        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 0.0;  (* Completely seal haulage scupper *)
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 80.0;
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 20.0;
        
        IF (rVotedCO_Concentration_ppm < 20.0) AND (rVotedNO2_Concentration_ppm < 1.0) AND (rToxicGas_CH4_LEL_pct < 5.0) THEN
            bToxicGasTripActive := FALSE;
            iFSM_CurrentState := 40;
        END_IF;
    
    90: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_DEPRESSURIZATION_LOCKOUT: Fail-safe isolation after catastrophic trip *)
        wSystemStateCode := 16#005A;
        rCascadeChilledWaterValve_pct := 0.0; (* Slam-shut high pressure water valve *)
        rPeltonTurbineBypass_pct := 100.0;   (* Open bypass deflector *)
        rAirCurtainFanSpeed_RPM := 0.0;        (* Stop blower *)
        rBarrierScupperDamper_pct := 100.0;    (* Open scupper to depressurize *)
        bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
        
        tEmergencyHoldTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF bResetFaults AND tEmergencyHoldTimer.Q AND bSafetyInterlockLoop AND NOT bWaterHammerLatch THEN
            tEmergencyHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iFSM_CurrentState := 0; (* Reset back to cold initialization *)
        END_IF;
    
    ELSE
        (* Undefined state safety recovery *)

END_CASE;
